newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen Media buys 5 radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen Media buys 5 radio stations.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp. said Friday it has signed deals to buy five radio stations in San Francisco and Philadelphia for $218 million.
Evergreen will buy KKSF-FM, KDFC-FM and KDFC-AM in San Francisco from Brown Organisation for $115 million, and WDAS-FM and WDAS-AM in Philadelphia from Beasley Broadcast Group for $103 million.
Evergreen also said it intends to sell or trade one of its Philadelphia FM stations to comply with federal telecommunications rules.

"We have no immediate plans to change the formats of any of the San Francisco or Philadelphia stations as we believe their current programming and our strengthened position in these markets will contribute to Evergreen's broadcast cash flow growth," the company said.
The deals are scheduled to close in the first quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval.
The acquistions bring Evergreen's network to 42 major market stations.
Evergreen's stock fell 25 cents to $30.75 on Nasdaq at midday.
